When saving your pet comes with guilt: The reality of starvation in Gaza
articles.summary:
When saving your pet comes with guilt: The reality of starvation in Gaza

In the latest episode of The Gaza Podcast, Palestinian journalist and human rights defender Maha Hussaini introduces her cat Tom, a fellow genocide survivor.

"He couldn’t understand the starvation, the occupation, the blockade or the genocide," Hussaini said. 

Having moved from one shelter to another throughout the war, Tom suffered an eye injury from a soot-covered pot and saw his weight drop in half during the peak of starvation in Gaza.

Maha shares the emotional reality of trying to keep a pet alive when food was nearly impossible to find, and how pets across Gaza continue to suffer as Israel continues to block the entry of essential veterinary supplies.

Trump suggests US may launch further attacks against Iran
articles.summary:
Trump suggests US may launch further attacks against Iran

US president Donald Trump suggested that Washington may launch more attacks targeting Iran. 

"This should have been done a long time ago by other presidents, the Iran war, and we’ve knocked the hell out of them, and we may do it a little bit further," he told reporters. 

In response to questions about the public reaction to the war on Ira, the US president said: "Well, in one way they love it because I’m doing what should have been done by other presidents. In another way, maybe they don’t."

"There’s a price to pay, which I knew immediately when I did it. But we can’t let Iran have a nuclear weapon."

archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat zvýšenou volatilitu na energetických trzích a nervozitu investorů vlivem blížících se izraelských voleb a napětí v Zálivu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, increased volatility in energy markets and investor nervousness are expected due to the upcoming Israeli elections and tensions in the Gulf.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu zůstává vysoce napjatá vlivem pokračujících střetů v Gaze, rostoucích útoků osadníků na Západním břehu během sklizně oliv a rétoriky USA a Íránu ohledně možných nových úderů. Blížící se izraelské volby navíc zvyšují politickou nestabilitu a vnitřní pnutí.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the region remains highly tense due to ongoing clashes in Gaza, escalating settler attacks in the West Bank during the olive harvest, and US-Iran rhetoric regarding potential new strikes. Additionally, the upcoming Israeli elections are increasing political instability and internal friction.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další zostření politické rétoriky před izraelskými volbami a pokračující volatilitu na energetických trzích v návaznosti na zprávy o Íránu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further sharpening of political rhetoric ahead of the Israeli elections and continued volatility in energy markets following reports regarding Iran can be expected.
